title: Shapes in God's World
memory_verse: "He sits above the circle of the earth." — Isaiah 40:22
objective: Students will learn to identify circles, squares, and triangles.
content: God's world is full of shapes! Let's learn about three shapes today: circles, squares, and triangles.
A circle is round like the sun and the moon. A square has four sides that are all the same. A triangle has three sides and three corners.
Look around you! A clock is a circle. A window can be a square. A slice of pizza is a triangle. God put shapes everywhere in His creation!
activity: Find circles, squares, and triangles in the room. Draw and color each shape. Use shapes to make a picture of a house.
discussion: How many sides does a triangle have?
Can you find a square in this room?
